Date: September 24, 2026
To,
The Manager – Listing Compliance,
National Stock Exchange of India Limited
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G,

Mumbai – 400 051
Symbol : ANONDITA
ISIN : INE0VTV01012
Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
Regulations, 2015, as amended (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) for allotment of equity shares on Rights
basis.
Dear Sir/Madam,
This refers to our earlier disclosure dated August 27, 2026, regarding the Rights Issue of up to 9,58,166 (Nine
Lakhs Fifty-Eight Thousand One Hundred Sixty-Six) fully paid-up equity shares of face value ₹10 each of the
Company for an amount aggregating up to ₹9,102.58 Lakhs (the "Rights Issue"), as revised by the Corrigendum
to the Letter of Offer dated September 07, 2026.
Pursuant to the communication received from National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("NSE") on the
Basis of Allotment of the Rights Issue, and in supersession of the Company's earlier communication in
this regard, the Company has revised the Basis of Allotment of the Rights Issue and made allotment on
the basis of the Issue Size as revised by the said Corrigendum.
Accordingly, we wish to inform you that the Rights Issue opened on Wednesday, September 09, 2026, and closed
on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, and pursuant to finalisation of the revised Basis of Allotment of the Rights
Issue, in consultation with Skyline Financial Services Private Limited ("Registrar to the Issue") and as approved
by NSE, being the designated stock exchange for the Rights Issue, the Board of Directors of the Company, at
their meeting held today, i.e., on September 24, 2026, inter-alia, have considered and approved the allotment of
9,58,166 (Nine Lakhs Fifty-Eight Thousand One Hundred Sixty-Six) fully paid-up equity shares of face value
₹10 each on rights basis to the eligible shareholders of the Company and/or renouncee(s), in terms of the Letter
of Offer dated August 27, 2026, read with the Corrigendum dated September 07, 2026, at an issue price of ₹950/-
per equity share.
Consequent to the said revised allotment, the paid-up equity share capital of the Company stands increased to
₹19,04,47,840. Details of pre and post Rights Issue paid-up share capital of the Company are as set out below:

Particulars No. of Equity Shares Total paid-up share Capital

The Board meeting commenced at 9:20 P.M and concluded at 9:45 P.M today.
The above information is also available on the Company’s website i.e. www.anonditamedicare.com
You are requested to kindly take the same on records.
Thanking you,
Yours truly,
